mapper.select: SELECT v.*, MATCH(v.title, v.director, v.actors, v.tags, v.description) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE) AS relevance FROM sys_video v WHERE MATCH(v.title, v.director, v.actors, v.tags, v.description) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE) AND v.status = 1 ORDER BY relevance DESC, v.play_count DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_video v WHERE MATCH(v.title, v.director, v.actors, v.tags, v.description) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE) AND v.status = 1
SELECT DISTINCT v.title FROM sys_video v WHERE MATCH(v.title) AGAINST(#{keyword} IN BOOLEAN MODE) AND v.status = 1 ORDER BY v.play_count DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT v.* FROM sys_video v WHERE (v.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR v.director LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR v.actors LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR v.tags LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) AND v.status = 1 ORDER BY v.play_count DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_video v WHERE (v.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR v.director LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR v.actors LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR v.tags LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')) AND v.status = 1
